gaps.spec_line: IOBoard.md:220 "ESC pack gate, external path above 150 A | a driven external module, whose driver output is on the IO board (F7) ... The module is a part off the board, bought at the second vendor of S3"
gaps.description: No external pack switch module has a part. selection.json (round 2, read 2026-10-03) holds part null for 'external pack switch module' (run FU-2J); only 'external module driver output' (TPSI3052DWZR) is selected. FU-2J/003-P2-R3.json returns the function with an empty shortlist and no dropped candidate, and FU-2J/008-rerank-R3.json ranks nothing, because V324 (owner, 2026-10-03) states the external path and its module are not known. The last research of the function is FU-2A/012-P2-R3.json (report 'external pack switch module': 'No module qualifies'; VS-FC420SA10 and VS-FC270SA20 draw no safe-operating-area line shorter than 100 us, read in FU-A3 and FU-2A). Fresh reading: vendors.py digikey-search "MOSFET N-CH 100V SOT-227" --limit 50, https://api.digikey.com/products/v4/search/keyword, read 2026-10-03T13:40:19Z: 32 rows; the only stocked non-Vishay SOT-227 100 V modules of an S1 maker are Microchip APT10M11JVRU3 (stock_available 18), APT10M11JVFR (10) and APT10M07JVFR (11), under the Digi-Key gate; the IXYS rows are not from an S1/S2 maker. A module is not a stage 2 part type (resistors, capacitors, inductors, crystals, connectors, connector protection, MOSFETs of R5's and R7's controllers), so the line is not 'stage 2 of round 2'. Owner accepted open 2026-10-03T11:40Z.

gaps.spec_line: IOBoard.md:219-220 and :422 "No part qualifies as the overvoltage and transient clamp" (ESC pack path; V45, V48, V54, V270, V324); switched-node freewheel diode of the external path
gaps.description: The 600 A external pack path has no clamp and no placed freewheel diode. selection.json (round 2, read 2026-10-03) holds part null for 'pack overvoltage and transient clamp' (FU-2J). V324 (owner, 2026-10-03) decides 'bus capacitance with damping, no clamp part' as a stage 2 requirement for the 300 A onboard path only (6 x 330 uF at 35 to 52 mOhm, simulated peak under 82 V, loop inductance assumed) and states 'The 600 A external path and the external pack switch module are not known'. FU-2J/003-P2-R3.json (read 2026-10-03T10:46Z to 10:58Z) selects STPS30H100DJF-TR for the onboard node and reports for the external path 'switched-node freewheel diode, external 600 A (not known, V324)': 'Where this diode sits on the external path is not known. Reported, not pass or fail'. FU-2A/012-P2-R3.json (report 'ESC pack node clamp level', 2026-10-01) gives the 600 A bank only as a simulation (about 3300 to 4700 uF at 20 to 30 mOhm, derived), and no part or requirement is fixed for it. The onboard capacitors are stage 2; the external path's clamp is neither a part nor a stage 2 requirement.

V321 (owner, 2026-10-03): 'Not known for now: the function stays without a part'. FU-2I/019-rerank-R6.json ranks only LTC4352CMS#TRPBF (C688177); FU-2I/027-adjudicator-R6.json (read_at 2026-10-03T02:17:01Z) upholds the stock refutation: need 5 boards x 4 placements = 20, gate max(5 x 20, 50) = 100. gaps.spec_line: Research.md V327 (R9, V+ OR element (new)) and IOBoard.md:473-474 cell monitor and its pack-side supply
gaps.description: The V+ OR element of the ADBMS1818 has no part. selection.json (round 2, read 2026-10-03) holds part null for 'V+ OR element' (FU-2J), 17 placements a board (16 pack-side taps and 1 supply-side branch). FU-2J/002-P2-R9.json (report 'V+ OR element: no part', Nexperia BAT46WJ, BAT46GW, PMEG10010ELR, PMEG10030ELP, PMEG100V060ELPD read 2026-10-03T10:48:33Z to 10:48:35Z, PMEG100T30ELP 10:53:15Z): no diode meets both V327's 0.3 V drop at 1.4 mA and V190's 10 uA unpowered draw at the top tap pin, which carries the summed reverse leakage of up to 15 blocked branches. FU-2J/010-adjudicator-R9.json (read_at 2026-10-03T11:59:36Z) upholds that no part is shown to meet both. Without it the V+ supply for packs under 16 V and the supply-side blocking of V327 are unbuilt. Owner accepted open 2026-10-03T11:40Z.

gaps.description: The found value is refuted and not re-run. FU-2I/003-P2-R5.json (found V96, 2026-10-03T00:22:23Z) is unchanged and no later run covers R5. The adjudicator's corrected statement stands as text only. Owner accepted open 2026-10-03.

gaps.spec_line: Research.md V173 and V287 (R8, Port current monitor): longest time from a port exceeding 3.0 A to the abort, and the critical line's blanking time; IOBoard.md:113, :389
gaps.description: The abort time and the blanking time are not found. FU-2I/002-P2-R8.json (2026-10-03T00:15:40Z): V173 'Not one figure': the first INA3221 conversion wholly above 3.0 A ends within 3.63 + 1.21 = 4.84 ms (SBOS576C 6.5), 'the abort follows after the blanking time, which is not read'; V287 'Blanking time: not read': SBOS576C 7.3.2.1 states when the transparent Critical pin pulls low and not when it releases with three channels enabled. V323 (owner, 2026-10-03) keeps the INA3221 and states the Critical pin's hold is not known and is measured on the bench before the order. FU-2I/011-P4-datasheet-R8.json (2026-10-03T01:03:54Z) confirms the 4.84 ms and the not-read status. The 5 ms firmware check and the 3.96 to 4.84 A port breaker act regardless.
